name: flow-language
description: Flow: tierless web language with a type-inferred client/server boundary — syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover and boundary colouring.

flow.serverPath.description: Path to src/lsp/server.ts. Empty = auto-detect: a workspace compiler checkout first, then the bundled copy.

flow.useWorkspaceServer.description: When the open folder is a Flow compiler checkout, run its src/lsp/server.ts (the code you are editing) instead of the server bundled with the extension.

flow.devWatch.description: Restart the language server automatically when files under the checkout's src/**.ts or stdlib/**.flow change. Applies only when running a compiler checkout, not the bundled server.

flow.cutColor.description: Colour of the underline and gutter marker for a cut that runs server work (client→server).

flow.cutInColor.description: Colour of the underline and gutter marker for a cut that pulls a value back to the client (→client).

flow.crossingColor.description: Colour of the dotted marker for a cross-tier expression resolved without a whole cut.

flow.enableDecorations.description: Colour client/server regions in the editor.
